abstract: Agent skill for NVIDIA NeMo Framework as split across github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo: pick between AutoModel (YAML fine-tuning and pretraining), Megatron-Bridge (Megatron-Core training and HF conversion) and NeMo RL (GRPO, DPO, SFT on Ray), install via uv or NGC containers, run recipes, scale on Slurm, convert checkpoints, troubleshoot and update. References per repo plus an AutoModel LoRA template and a NeMo RL smoke script.
